comments.author: Cash
comments.body:
This ship is out and is everything it stacks up to be!

Really, the only downside is that this cannot have 5 broadside cannon slots but seriously outperforms any other “standard” ship in its class.

Skill set is nothing short of amazing and can go to 9 mods total

I’d post the base stats but no time.

comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
I've the ship here mate, the base stats are as follow:

Dura - 910
Vertical Sail - 313
Horizontal Sail - 133
Turnspeed - 10 (not certain as I designed it on -25 % which shows 11)
Wave Resistance - 13
Armour - 35
Crew (max refit) - 135
Chamber (max refit) - 42
Hold (minimum hold refit and -25 %) - 213

Mod slot: 8+1
Standard paneled - Nocturnal Metal Panel
Sail Slots: 5, Armouring: 2, Broadisde: 4, Special Equipment: 1, No Bow/Stern Turrets, Crest slot:1 and figurehead:1

Hope this helps ^^

comments.author: CaliCaddy
comments.body: If you are building a plan for this ship on uwotool's Armed Sha-chuan, keep in mind that the -25% on Shadow Armed Sha-chuan gives -25 to sails and -5 to wave resistance, instead of -30 and -6 for the regular Armed Sha-chuan.
